description: RYOBI Introduces the ONE+ 18V Cordless 2-Tool Combo Kit with Multitool and Reciprocating Saw (Tools Only). With higher power and up to 20,000 maximum OPM (oscillations per minute), this 18V ONE+ cordless multitool can take the most demanding applications. This multi-tool features the lowest vibration in its class, helping to reduce user fatigue and ensure accurate accuracy. The adjustable speed dial gives the ability to make cuts in drywall, metal, wood, plastic, composite and many other materials, along with the ability to sand the finest details. Equipped with a 1 in. Stroke length and 3,400 SPM, this cordless reciprocating saw is ideal for quick cuts through mutile materials. Easy blade release lever ensures simple blade changes to quickly switch between cutting applications to complete 145+ cuts per charge. Best of all, it's part of the RYOBI ONE+ system of over 260 cordless tools that work on the same battery platform. This 18V ONE+ cordless 2-tool combo kit includes a cordless multitool with plunge cutting blade, finishing cutting blade, sanding pad, (3) pieces of sandpaper assortment, a cordless reciprocating saw with 6 in. Wood cutting blade and operator's manual. Battery and charger sold separately.
